title.en: Reading concrete pump integral piston φ150 with the section names of Ebonite
title.zh: 用来源页《Ebonite》的章节名来读concrete pump integral piston φ150

description.en: Ebonite provides the section names for concrete pump integral piston φ150. A φ150 integral piston is one outer-diameter row on the Xingtai one-piece piston page. The unit is a piece. Material is a missing field. No published pump page names φ150 as its piston.
description.zh: 《Ebonite》为concrete pump integral piston φ150提供章节名。φ150 整体活塞是邢台整体活塞页上的一条外径。单位是个。材料是缺字段。没有已公布泵页把 φ150 写成自己的活塞。

h1.en: concrete pump integral piston φ150 without figures beyond the row, under Ebonite
h1.zh: concrete pump integral piston φ150不超出已印行，标题来自《Ebonite》

directAnswer.en: concrete pump integral piston φ150 is restated below in Hebei Pinjin Machinery’s own catalogue words. The section order is the order of Ebonite, and that page is not a second nameplate. A φ150 integral piston is one outer-diameter row on the Xingtai one-piece piston page. The unit is a piece. Material is a missing field. No published pump page names φ150 as its piston.
directAnswer.zh: concrete pump integral piston φ150下面用河北品锦机械目录里已经有的说法重述。章节次序来自《Ebonite》，那一页不是第二块铭牌。 φ150 整体活塞是邢台整体活塞页上的一条外径。单位是个。材料是缺字段。没有已公布泵页把 φ150 写成自己的活塞。

body.en: “Properties” does not grade a material and does not assign a machine that the row itself does not name. The integral piston page lists φ150, φ160, φ180, φ195, φ200, φ205, φ210, φ220, φ225, φ230 and φ250, sold per piece, as replacement parts rather than OEM parts of other brands. This note is only φ150. Rubber, rubber-cloth and polyurethane are printed on the split-piston page, not as a material for this integral row. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. The split-piston page also lists φ150, with its own material row and a set as the unit. Same outer diameter does not merge the two parts. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Write integral piston, φ150, and the quantity in pieces. Do not add a material the page does not print. No neighbouring page’s figure is copied onto this row.
body.zh: “性能”不评定材料，也不把目录行没有点名的机器指定过来。 整体活塞页列出 φ150, φ160, φ180, φ195, φ200, φ205, φ210, φ220, φ225, φ230 and φ250，按个供货，并写明是替换件，不是其他品牌原厂件。本文只写 φ150。橡胶、橡胶夹布和聚氨酯印在分体活塞页上，不是这一整体活塞行的材料。 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。分体活塞页也有 φ150，那边有自己的材料行，单位是套。外径相同也不会把两件配件并成一件。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 写明整体活塞、φ150 和个数。不要补上页面没有印的材料。 不把旁边那一页的数字抄到这一行。

body.en: “Contamination” organises the source article. Organised under it here is catalogue language, unchanged in its figures. A φ150 integral piston is one outer-diameter row on the Xingtai one-piece piston page. The unit is a piece. Material is a missing field. No published pump page names φ150 as its piston. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. A service life, a replacement-hour figure and a wear-rate table are not printed. Leave that field blank. The outline does not complete a blank.
body.zh: “污染”用来组织来源文章。组织在它下面的，是目录里的说法，数字保持原样。 φ150 整体活塞是邢台整体活塞页上的一条外径。单位是个。材料是缺字段。没有已公布泵页把 φ150 写成自己的活塞。 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 使用寿命、更换小时和磨损速率都没有印出。这一栏留空。 大纲补不上空白格子。

body.en: The skeleton of this section is the source heading “Applications”. The technical content is only what Xingtai already printed. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. The page calls them Xingtai replacement wear parts, not OEM parts of other pump brands. Email or WhatsApp Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai, and name the 整体活塞 page plus this size and the quantity. Unprinted cells stay unprinted. Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ebonite
body.zh: 这一节的骨架是来源标题“用途”。技术内容只限于邢台已经印出的部分。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 页面写的是邢台替换易损件，不是其他泵品牌的原厂件。 用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给邢台河北品锦机械，写明整体活塞这一页、这一尺寸和数量。 没有印出的格子保持不印。 图来自来源页：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ebonite

question.en: Which printed fragment stays in force when the section is “Properties” for concrete pump integral piston φ150?
question.zh: 章节为“性能”时，concrete pump integral piston φ150仍以哪一句已印文字为准？

answer.en: This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. The heading and the source photograph do not add a further figure.
answer.zh: 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 章节标题和来源图片都不另加数字。
